Minutes of the Executive Board's monetary policy meeting, May 2026

Economic developments

The Swedish economy is growing at a moderate pace. GDP growth was projected to be 1.7% in 2026.

Inflation

Inflation is expected to be close to the target of 2% in the coming years. The Executive Board assessed that inflation was expected to average 2.3% in 2027.

Financial conditions

Financial conditions have improved, and funding costs have fallen.

The monetary policy assessment

The Executive Board judged that the policy rate would be appropriate to keep at a restrictive level. The Board agreed that future decisions would depend on the incoming data. A majority of the Board assessed that the risks to the inflation outlook were broadly balanced.
